epistemic_knowledge.note: Knowledge<T> with GUM uncertainty propagation, epsilon confidence, provenance tracking.

linear_types.note: linear struct enforces consume-exactly-once. No clone, no drop.

effects_system.note: IO, Mut, Div, Panic, Alloc, Async, GPU, Prob, Observe.

causal_types.note: Intervention<T> and Counterfactual<T> are compiler-level types. Stdlib DAG API (do_intervention, average_treatment_effect) exists.

refinement_types.note: Parser + type checker support refinement predicates. SMT solver integration planned for 2026.

units.note: Compile-time dimensional analysis. Unit definitions, conversions, arithmetic.

ontology.note: Stdlib modules exist for SNOMED, GO, HPO, LOINC. Feature gate disabled in beta.4.

smt_prover.note: Disabled in beta.4. Refinement types work without SMT via type checker.

self_hosted.note: Fixed point achieved. gen2==gen3 bit-identical. 230KB ELF.

observer_types.note: Unobserved<T> with Observe effect for quantum/Bayesian observation boundaries.

algebra_system.note: algebra declarations with Fano-selective e-graph rewriting.
